versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

Initial release of content-desk for content inventory only.

- Provides read-only, local or TrustGrowth content inventory—no content editing, generation, or publication features.
- Supports source detection, running inventories, delivering value, and recommending at most one missing connector.
- Returns counts by content status/type, stale or incomplete records, duplicates, provenance, and a concise needs-human list.
- Fully enforces TrustGrowth plan and feature limits; no workarounds for waitlist-managed features.
- Follows strict evidence and ethics doctrine; does not allow content pipeline writes or inference from filenames.
